name: chronos
description: Check Codex degradation, approval amplification, rule health, and bounded worker delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Codex health and govern bounded workers.
interface.longDescription: Check Windows process, memory, disk, diagnostic-log, token-quota, approval persistence, permission-rule, reviewer-escalation, lineage, fork-context, and rollout health, then govern bounded Codex workers using runtime model discovery, canonical workspace identity, fenced leases, strict write attribution, scope, privacy, and verification limits.
defaultPrompt: Use Chronos to inspect current Codex resource health.
Use Chronos to recommend the safest response to current Codex lag.
Use Chronos to explain current token and quota pressure.
Use Chronos Governor to delegate one bounded low-complexity repository task.
